AVAILABLE NOW | Fully Furnished | Studio Apartment | Deansgate Area | Great Transport Routes & Walking Distance to the City Centre

Description

Furnished studio apartment in Pall Mall House - ideal for City Centre living. 

This fantastic studio offers a separate kitchen to the living quarters giving occupiers more space, whilst the living area has a private balcony - a rare find for such a central location. 

Pall Mall House is a converted warehouse located on Church Street in the heart of the Northern Quarter. The conversion has been done exquisitely and there are many features throughout with a art deco styled communal area. The building is 8 storey high with the lower two floors occupied by commercial space. Located well for all the City Centre has to offer, this particular location is popular being so close to the bars, restaurants and independent shops that the Northern Quarter is famous for.

The block is accessed via secure entry system directly from Church Street and there are two lifts and stairs to all floors.

This property has cladding, as far as we know the current position with the property is: It’s been tested and there are no works required.*
*You should make enquires about the external wall system of the property, if it has cladding and if it is safe or if there are interim measure in place.
